recommended_phases.title: Phase 1 — Shared foundations: accrual date helpers + query param extension
recommended_phases.rationale: Extract startOfUtcDay/addMonths/periodContaining into src/shared/date/accrual.ts and add employeeIds to LeaveRequestQueryParams. No module depends on these yet; both are leaf changes. Add direct unit tests incl. TZ=Asia/Riyadh.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 2 — Employee: password_hash migration, findByManagerId, service methods
recommended_phases.rationale: Add nullable password_hash migration, extend Employee model/repository (findByManagerId) and service (getEmployeeByEmail, getEmployeesByManagerId). Auth and leave list both depend on these.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 3 — Policy: getActivePolicies service exposure
recommended_phases.rationale: Add IPolicyService.getActivePolicies(asOf) calling existing findAll, filtering ACTIVE + effective window, latest effective_from. Balance depends on it; no new repository method.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 4 — Auth module: login service + POST /auth/login + public path
recommended_phases.rationale: New auth module with IAuthService.login (bcrypt.compare + signToken), route, and add /auth/login to PUBLIC_PATHS. Depends on employee (Phase 2) and shared-auth.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 5 — Balance: getBalancesForEmployee + GET /balances/me
recommended_phases.rationale: Add IBalanceService.getBalancesForEmployee using getActivePolicies + shared-date periodContaining + findByKey; add route. Depends on Phases 1, 3.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 6 — Leave reads: findByQuery employeeIds, list/getById, GET /leaves + /leaves/:id
recommended_phases.rationale: Extend findByQuery to honor employeeIds (ANY), add ILeaveService.list/getById with role scoping + visibility, add routes. Depends on Phases 1, 2.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 7 — Employee /me route + smoke check extension + unit tests
recommended_phases.rationale: Add GET /employees/me route, extend scripts/smoke.js with login+read stages asserting real values, and add unit tests for new routes/services. Depends on all prior phases.

app_notes: Application slice for auth + read endpoints. New auth module (login) plus read routes on employee/leave/balance. Shared UTC date arithmetic extracted to src/shared/date/accrual.ts (single copy consumed by both LeaveService and BalanceService). LeaveRequestQueryParams gains employeeIds for role scoping pushed into findByQuery (employee_id = ANY($n)). Policy exposes getActivePolicies (at most one ACTIVE policy per leaveTypeCode, latest effective_from) via existing findAll — no new repository method, no balance->leave-type dependency. Employee gains password_hash (nullable), findByManagerId, getEmployeeByEmail, getEmployeesByManagerId. Read endpoints never open a transaction and never write. Login uses bcrypt.compare + existing signToken; wrong email/password indistinguishable; password_hash never serialized. /auth/login added to PUBLIC_PATHS.

open_questions.question: GET /balances/me available computation when no balance row exists for a policy's current period
open_questions.impact: Determines whether the endpoint returns an entry with entitledDays=policy.annualEntitlementDays and used/pending=0 (available=entitlement) or omits the leave type entirely. Affects client rendering and smoke assertions.
candidate_options: Return a synthesized entry with entitledDays=policy.annualEntitlementDays, usedDays=0, pendingDays=0, available=entitlement
Omit the leave type when no balance row exists for the current period

open_questions.question: GET /leaves/:id visibility for a MANAGER whose direct report's request is APPROVED/REJECTED/CANCELLED vs DRAFT/SUBMITTED
open_questions.impact: The spec says MANAGER sees "their own plus those of employees whose manager_id is the manager" with no status restriction, but the existing approve/reject authorization only lets a manager act on SUBMITTED. If visibility is status-unrestricted, a manager can read (but not act on) any status; if restricted, the list and by-id rules diverge from the stated rule.
candidate_options: Status-unrestricted: manager sees all statuses of direct reports (matches the literal spec)
Restrict to SUBMITTED only (matches the existing decide authorization)

auth_contract: request.user: { id: string; role: EmployeeRole } where EmployeeRole = 'EMPLOYEE' | 'MANAGER' | 'ADMIN'. Identity/role obtained from a JWT bearer token verified by the existing registerAuth preHandler hook (src/shared/auth/index.ts), which decodes sub->id and role and populates request.user; missing/invalid token -> UnauthorizedError (401). RBAC enforced at the API boundary via resolveActor (role membership check) and in services (leave visibility scoping: EMPLOYEE self, MANAGER self+direct reports, ADMIN all). POST /auth/login is the sole public (unauthenticated) endpoint added to PUBLIC_PATHS.
error_response_contract: Errors return { error: string; code: string }. Validation failure -> 400 ValidationError; authentication failure -> 401 UnauthorizedError; authorization failure -> 403 ForbiddenError; not found -> 404 NotFoundError (GET /leaves/:id returns the SAME 404 for invisible and nonexistent ids); invalid state -> 409 ConflictError; other -> 500 { error: 'Internal Server Error' }. Login failure (wrong email OR password) returns a single indistinguishable 401.
